_ad_placement_lessons: beehiiv auto-accepts a small set of ad opportunities per cycle (visible via list_ad_opportunities status=accepted). Embed the ACCEPTED OPPORTUNITY id (a uuid), NOT the rotating offer id from list_ad_offers. Passing offer ids triggers a fresh acceptance and fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities' once the cycle's quota is used. A post also has only ONE 'primary' ad slot: set data-advertisement-kind=primary on at most one ad, all others 'secondary'. This run placed 3 real ads (1 primary + 2 secondary) using accepted opportunity ids.
